title: Bad input is refused before any network call
description: Malformed dates, out-of-range limits, unknown enums, empty or oversized content, too many ids, unknown note or checklist ids each return a tool error naming the problem.
criterion: Malformed dates, out-of-range limits, unknown enums, empty or oversized content, too many ids, unknown note or checklist ids each return a tool error naming the problem; schema/Go checks fire with zero Firestore requests for input errors.
prerequisites: Go 1.27+, Node 20+ (for the web-side checks). No network, no real account: a local fake Firebase is used.
